raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 3, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “our nation’s history” (U.S.) by selecting the 1762 Battle of Manila (Seven Years’ War), which predates U.S. nationhood, instead of the U.S.-related 1898 battle, and prematurely concluded Manila was earlier than the Seven Days Battles without verifying the intended Manila reference.
